definitions: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way.
The capacity or ability to direct or influence the behaviour of others or the course of events.
Political or social authority or control.
A country or organisation that has a lot of influence or control.
Energy that is produced by mechanical, electrical, or other means and used to operate machines or devices.
examples: She has the power to make decisions.
The party came to power in 2010.
He lifted the box with surprising power.
The great powers of the world.
The house runs on solar power.
